tag_provenance.icp_tier: From DB 4 Tier's five approved options. SYN-S10-01 carries NO ICP classification - its five checks are scope and anti-ICP screens - so Out-of-scope is the only option that asserts nothing about a real company.
tag_provenance.offer_id: Offer (02) has never defined an id format. This string defines no production format.

payload.fit_verdict_note: S10 produces no fit verdict. The input's SIMULATED_VERDICT is not carried forward.
payload.boundary_law: Angle, never artifact. No angle was assembled - it needs timing, pain and language, none of which was read - and no email, proposal or script was written.
